mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tighter monetary policy stance, which compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Correlation between FEDFUNDS level and 20d SPX returns is positive (>=0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and RSAFS both rise > 0.1pp from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 60% of instances when PAYEMS and RSAFS both rise > 0.1pp, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), a monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.3% signals accelerating inflation that forces the central bank to further tighten policy, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weaker labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Correlation between UNRATE level and 5d SPX returns is positive (>=0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% from the prior month signals a weakening real estate sector, which reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST falls > 10%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both fall > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 60% of instances when INDPRO and HOUST both fall > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS rises > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
